outcome: A new workspace is created with its starter content.

acceptance_criteria.text: The bundle shipped with the product decodes into the expected starter rows.

expected_verification.assertion: the default bundle decodes to its first row

acceptance_criteria.text: A bundle that did not come from the product is rejected rather than seeded.

expected_verification.assertion: a bundle without a valid signature or of unexpected shape is refused

data_impact: Decoded rows are written into a new workspace.
security_impact: Unvalidated externally-supplied content becoming workspace data is an injection point into every surface that later renders it.
